title: am i cooked chat…??? (ppo got rejected)
description:
I lost my PPO (Pre-Placement Offer) at Texas Instruments (TI), and honestly, I am completely cooked.

I went from thinking my near future was completely secure to being right back at square one. In this video, I’m being 100% transparent about the corporate rejection, the intense rage, and the grumpy, frustrated headspace I’ve been stuck in ever since getting the news.

If you've ever had a corporate door slammed in your face at the last second, or if you're currently navigating the brutal tech hiring market, you are not alone. Let's talk about it in the comments. Am I cooked, chat?

#CareerUpdate #TI #PrePlacementOffer #TechLayoffs #CorporateRejection #Unemployed #EngineeringLife #AmICooked

title: When 2 Months of Hard Work Ends With “No”
description:
I got rejected for my PPO at Texas Instruments.

It hurts when you genuinely love what you do and give something your absolute best, only to hear “unfortunately” at the end.

But I’m grateful for the people I met, the lessons I learned, and the memories I made during those two months.

Maybe this isn’t the ending I wanted.
But it’s not the end. ❤️

If you’ve ever faced rejection after giving something everything you had, you’re not alone.


#texasinstruments  #ti #internship  #rejection  #engineeringstudent  #StudentLife #career  #internshipexperience  #youtubeshorts

title: Thank You, Destin Daniel Cretton & Marvel Studios
description:
This video is my heartfelt thank you to Destin Daniel Cretton, Marvel Studios, and everyone involved in making Spider-Man: Brand New Day.

Spider-Man has inspired millions around the world, and seeing his journey continue means so much to fans like me. Thank you for believing in this character and giving us another chapter to look forward to.

We're excited for what's next. ❤️🕷️

If you're a fellow Spider-Man fan, let me know what you're most excited to see in Spider-Man: Brand New Day.
